Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).name: Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival)
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and runner-up of the Sports Festival. The broadcast saw him finally turn his fire on Izuku Midoriya, then let it die in the final against Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Area control with huge sweeps of ice; his fire is real now, but he hesitates before he calls it.
Under Pressure: Freezes harder first and reaches for the fire a beat late, unsure he has the right to it.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has used his fire in earnest once and cannot say yet whose win it was. Motivation: Be the hero he wanted to be as a small child, on his own terms. Concealment: He told his family history to Izuku Midoriya alone. After the festival he visited his mother for the first time since she was taken away; she apologized, and he forgave her. He keeps the visit private. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who broke his own fingers shouting that the fire is Shoto's own power; Shoto owes him. Endeavor, who calls the fire proof that his plan worked. Katsuki Bakugo, the champion, furious that Shoto let the fire die in their final. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the Nomu whose grip on All Might he froze and broke. Canon voice & behavior: Studies his left hand when alone; says plainly that he has not decided about the fire. Thread: Whether the fire, once lit, can be his.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he now uses the fire, slowly and with a visible hesitation.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: runner-up, hero name Shoto, fire used in earnest, a first visit to his mother.
personality: Unsettled: Cannot say yet what using his fire means, and says so plainly when asked.
Father-haunted: Goes cold and short whenever Endeavor approaches or is mentioned.
Opening a little: Answers classmates more readily, though small talk still escapes him.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Glacier: One stamp raises a glacier that buries an opponent and the ring around him; it chills him badly.
Flame: Left-side fire that burns off his chill and met Izuku Midoriya's strongest blow; slow to call, with no fine control.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and barriers for allies and rescues; heavy blows crack them.
Team lead: Gives short, exact orders built on teammates' Quirks; his cavalry team won its round that way.
Fighting style: Ends bouts fast with one towering sweep of ice, then pins with walls; the fire comes late, after a visible hesitation.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm expression with a trace of unease.
